about: Zero-shot genre anchors for the CLAP sound print: each lane is a sound, filed under one MUMOO style (and so its genre and sub-genre), described five ways (drums, bass, tempo feel, instruments), and some also by short tag-style lines like the labels this CLAP model was trained on. A lane's anchor is the mean of its prompts' text embeddings.
